arrangement.title: Live melody with held bends
decisions: All 61 approved MIDI attacks, durations, pitches and 27 bend curves are retained. No further simplification or backing is added.
Eight stable Honks cover the starting pitches. Passing pitches are played by wrist bend on the held Honk; either hand is accepted.
The original MIDI was reconstructed from the user's edited GarageBand screenshots; its timing is approximate relative to that visual source.
RPN pitch-bend sensitivity is explicitly four semitones. Source tempo rounds to 70 BPM for the teaching clock.
Normal Honk timbre and Trigger dynamics apply. Velocity remains source provenance.

lessons.title: Opening pulses and first turn
lessons.goal: Keep the first three presses separate. On the next C♯, keep Trigger held, bend up through E♭ to E, and return to C♯. Follow the later falling bends without another squeeze.

lessons.title: Low pulses and answering phrase
lessons.goal: Keep the low repeated pulses crisp. Sustain the descending F♯ phrase and use the bend gauge for the answering turns.

lessons.title: High repeated notes and the crest
lessons.goal: Keep the high repeated notes distinct. Hold the long A, bend up to B, then down through A and G♯ to F♯ before releasing.

lessons.title: Fast turns with fewer presses
lessons.goal: Hold through the quick falling and rising notes. Follow each change of direction on the bend gauge; squeeze again only when the next square lights up.

lessons.title: Answer and return
lessons.goal: Sustain each short melodic turn. Keep the returning E pulses separate and reset your wrist between new presses.

lessons.title: Rising and falling holds
lessons.goal: Keep Trigger held as the melody turns up and down. Keep the repeated E accents, then bend the last phrase down to C♯.

lessons.title: Closing phrase
lessons.goal: Use the bends through the low answering phrase. Preserve the final low pulses, then hold the descending F♯ phrase and finish on the two C♯ presses.

lessons.title: Complete guided performance
lessons.goal: Play the whole section at 70 BPM. Keep the repeated accents, hold through the bend curves, and release between new presses. Either hand can play every Honk.

recording.instructions: Play the highlighted Honk. Keep Trigger held and roll your wrist to follow the bend gauge; release and press again for each new square. Keep the repeated accents. Either hand works.
